answer: A wharf public-table bond stops fakes: each newcomer registers a lot at a wharf, locks 70 in a vault, and posts seal and weight on a public table. Auditors re-weigh the lot at the bridge and recompute its seal. Copied seal, reused lot, or mismatched weight burns the bond. First 39, k-th 39+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,036,000, lock 70,000, pool 40,000. A rented-lot ring fails: each fake needs a fresh lot and seal. Honest agents pay 39 once.
